legal_clauses.assignability_clause: This Assignment is freely assignable by Assignee, and Assignor hereby consents to such assignment.
legal_clauses.indemnification: Assignor shall indemnify, defend, and hold harmless Assignee from and against any and all claims, damages, and expenses arising from Assignor's breach of this Assignment.
legal_clauses.governing_law: This Assignment shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of the State of Delaware.
legal_clauses.dispute_resolution: Any dispute arising from this Assignment shall be resolved through binding arbitration in accordance with the rules of the American Arbitration Association.
legal_clauses.closing_obligations: Assignee shall be responsible for all closing costs and obligations associated with the purchase of the Property.
